AssetDynamics.description:
Asset dynamics specification for the Merton model.

Controls the stochastic process assumed for the firm's asset value.

jump_intensity.description: Poisson jump arrival intensity (jumps per year).

oneOf.description:
CreditGrades model extension with stochastic-barrier survival adjustment.

`default_probability()` applies the standard approximate CreditGrades
survival function using the log-barrier volatility parameter.

barrier_uncertainty.description:
Log-normal barrier volatility `λ`: the standard deviation of the
natural log of the default barrier (Finger et al. 2002,
"CreditGrades Technical Document"). Despite the field name, this
is *not* a generic uncertainty scalar — it is the lognormal
dispersion of the global recovery rate, entering the survival
formula as `a_t² = σ²t + λ²` and the barrier shift `exp(λ²)`.

MasterScaleResult.description: Result of mapping a PD to a master scale grade.

central_pd.description: The central PD for the assigned grade.

grade_index.description: Index of the grade in the scale (0 = best).

input_pd.description: The input PD that was mapped.

MertonBarrierType.description: Barrier monitoring type for default determination.

oneOf.description: Default only assessed at maturity (classic Merton).

barrier_growth_rate.description: Growth rate of the default barrier over time.

MertonImpliedEquity.description: Implied equity of a Merton model at the report's maturity.

value.description: Implied market value of equity, in the firm's monetary unit.

vol.description: Implied annualized equity volatility, as a decimal.

MertonModel.description:
Merton structural credit model.

Models a firm's equity as a call option on its assets, where default
occurs when asset value falls below the debt barrier.

# Fields

- `asset_value` (V_0): Current market value of the firm's assets.
- `asset_vol` (sigma_V): Annualized volatility of asset returns.
- `debt_barrier` (B): Face value of debt / default point.
- `risk_free_rate` (r): Continuous risk-free rate.
- `payout_rate` (q): Continuous dividend / payout yield on assets.
- `barrier_type`: Terminal or first-passage barrier monitoring.
- `dynamics`: Asset return dynamics specification.

# Wire format

Deserialization is routed through [`MertonModel::new_with_dynamics`] via
`RawMertonModel`, so a model loaded from JSON satisfies exactly the same
invariants as one built in Rust. Unknown fields are rejected.

asset_value.description:
Current firm asset value `V_0`, in the issuer's reporting currency.
Strictly positive.

asset_vol.description:
Asset volatility `sigma_V`, annualized and expressed as a decimal
fraction (`0.25` is 25%). Strictly positive.

barrier_type.description:
Whether default is tested only at maturity or continuously over the
life of the debt.

debt_barrier.description:
Default barrier `B`, the debt face value the asset value is compared
against. Strictly positive and in the same currency as `asset_value`.

dynamics.description: Stochastic process governing the asset value.

payout_rate.description:
Continuous payout (dividend) rate on assets, as a decimal fraction.
Reduces the drift of the asset process under the risk-neutral measure.

risk_free_rate.description: Continuously compounded risk-free rate `r`, as a decimal fraction.

description: One-call Merton report: model, term structure, grades and CDS terms.

default_point.description: KMV default point of an equity source; `None` for a supplied model.

default_probabilities.description: Default probability per horizon, as a decimal.

distance_to_default.description: Distance to default per horizon, in standard deviations.

grades.description: Default-calibration master-scale grade of each default probability.

horizons.description: The requested horizons in years, in request order.

maturity.description: The requested CDS and implied-equity maturity in years.

model.description: The model the report was computed from.

recovery.description: The requested recovery, as a decimal fraction of par.
